title.value: AU Base Imaging Result (TEST - mandatory anatomicRegionOfInterest)

description.value: TEST ARTEFACT - NOT FOR PUBLICATION. Derived from AU Base Diagnostic Imaging Result purely to exercise Observation.category slicing. It raises Observation.category:anatomicRegionOfInterest to 1..1 so that the required binding to the NCTS Imaging Anatomic Region Of Interest value set must be satisfied by a discriminated slice. Used to demonstrate that the slice discriminator and its constraints operate, rather than silently matching nothing.

short.value: Anatomic region of interest (mandatory in this test profile)
